    HOW IT WORKS

    An important event occurs. Assignment editor quickly creates a new location based event on the Snappers web platform

    the platform

    2.

    3.

    The users will receive a push notification (using Snappers' SDK implementation in the sport & media outlet's app) allowing them to start snapping the event live.  

    4.
